name: Infinite Toki
guide_text: The most common curve with this hero is to level hero power on turn 4, so turn 5 you can buy 2 good 4 drops, and play the game from there.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up when it costs 3-5 to discover an early turn 6 drop. Much better with Brann.
